# Vanguard Conservative Portfolio Investment Policy v2.1

## Portfolio Objectives
The primary objective of conservative portfolios is capital preservation with modest growth. These portfolios are designed for clients with low risk tolerance and short-to-medium investment horizons.

## Asset Allocation Targets
| Asset Class | Target Range | Rebalancing Threshold |
|-----------|-------------|---------------------|
| Equities | 15-25% | ±5% from midpoint |
| Fixed Income | 60-75% | ±7% from midpoint |
| Real Estate | 0-10% | ±3% from midpoint |
| Cash & Equivalents | 5-15% | ±4% from midpoint |

## Rebalancing Guidelines
1. Rebalance when any asset class deviates beyond its rebalancing threshold
2. Prioritize tax-efficient rebalancing (use tax-loss harvesting when possible)
3. Consider transaction costs and market impact
4. Document all rebalancing decisions in the client portfolio review

## Risk Management
- Monitor portfolio volatility (target: <8% annualized)
- Stress test portfolios quarterly using historical crisis scenarios
